subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: After the CLI-to-embedded propagation defect is fixed, should OpenClaw land this embedded-only fail-closed mitigation while the linked issue remains open for other delegation surfaces?
rationale: The remaining rollout intentionally changes policy on one surface while other work-delegation tools stay mechanically available, which source correctness cannot decide.

options.title: Land repaired mitigation
options.body: Fix the missing propagation, prove the CLI-to-embedded case, and accept the embedded guard as a staged mitigation.

options.title: Require full OpenClaw parity
options.body: Hold the PR until all OpenClaw-owned spawning, sending, and scheduling surfaces enforce the same policy.

options.title: Pause the policy change
options.body: Close or redesign the PR if tool-specific fail-closed behavior is not the desired fallback policy.

recommendation.title: Land repaired mitigation
recommendation.body: Fix the missing propagation, prove the CLI-to-embedded case, and accept the embedded guard as a staged mitigation.
